Fighting Hope - Elderly Abuse (East London)

By: Sasha Schwendenwein | Delivery

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
Smacked, punched, kicked - serious abuse at a high end elderly facility in East London. This Sunday on Carte Blanche we bring you the exclusive footage and interviews with the family of the victim.

Summary:
Clips show the assaults, which took place on February 3 and 23. In the video, seen by the Daily Dispatch, Shepherd is assaulted with open hands, fists and elbows by a caregiver. In one clip the caregiver stops the assaults to close the door and curtains in Shepherd’s room before she continues assaulting the frail pensioner, even dishing out a fly-kick to the stomach. Shepherd’s feeble attempts to fight back are met with more violence. She is grabbed by her hair and roughly thrown down on her bed, where the assault continues. In another clip the caregiver is seen smashing her elbow into the elderly woman’s head and back. The footage also shows the woman taking a deodorant can and bashing it against Shepherd’s head, before spraying its contents into a breathing hole in Shepherd’s throat. The elderly woman suffers from throat cancer

Home lilly kirchmann in EL.
Flashbacks – they took her out of the old age home. Took her to a psychiatrist.
Family home environment – the change the unbelievable – starting to talk and walk again. She wasn’t allowed to even walk.
Criminal cases made against the nurses – the nurse appeared in court
The abuse was discovered in December.

Her daughter was having to feed her. She went every day. She had bruises and she kept having them. The nurses made up excuses. Put her to bed on the 6th December, she was fine, but the next day, she had a broken arm. X ray’s. Doctor said “funny break”
Put a camera into her room.
23rd of February – she had black eyes. Again she fell. She downloaded the footage. She couldn’t believe what was going on.
Ncediswa Mkenkcele appeared in court.

Tieing her to the bed for hours. Pull her out of bed when she was sleep.
http://www.dispatchlive.co.za/gen/how-hope-84-was-tortured/


Further information:
We got exclusive interviews with the shepherd family - including hope. We also spoke with the alleged abuser Ncendiswa and she for the first time told her chilling tale of what lead her to beat an 84 year old woman. The actual facility - Lily Kirchmann - sits down with us and explains how this happened on the watch.

Press Release:


Elder Abuse
Exclusive footage of the brutal assault of an 84-year old woman entrusted to the care of an East London facility for the aged. Following a series of unexplained injuries, her family installed a hidden camera and were horrified with the footage that followed, depicting ongoing, brutal assaults by a nurse with open hands, fists and elbows, being kicked, grabbed by the hair and more. Carte Blanche speaks exclusively with the family and victim and hears a controversial justification by her attacker.


Script:


Meet Hope Faith Shepherd.
Soundup “you must love h

At 84 she looks at peace flipping through her photo album, however, two months ago she was forced to defend herself from a brutal attack...
“Footage of abuse...”

Hope is a devout Christian who raised her 5 children in the coastal town of East London. She survived throat cancer and after a laryngectomy, in which her voice box was removed, she learned to speak again, and worked in her daughter Bernice Robertson’s office.
BR “She would draw on wind to speak. She just didn’t want to give up work, she always used to say to me, if you make me stop working im going to lose her mind.
Hope lived with Bernice and her husband, but in 2013 after pneumonia and hip replacement surgery, the family couldn’t ignore that she needed specialized care and chose the Bearea retirement foundation.
LINK: Hopes family were confident that she would be comfortable secure and loved, here, is a well known care facility, the Lily Kirchmann’s complex – It’s not cheap - at 14,000 rand a month.
BR “It was very jacked up, very clean.” 9.13
LINK: Hope was in the assisted living section and with the onset of dementia her behaviour started to change. It was decided to move her to the frail care section and that’s where she stopped walking and even stopped talking.
Bernice visited her mother twice every day…
11.30: “In the morning I would go and change her, and every night feed her.”
She started noticing what appeared to her to be unexplained injuries on her mother…
“But she was always full of bruises, and I was always questioning the bruises.”12.25
In December last year, Bernice took Hope to a doctor only to find her wrist was fractured.
The family’s suspicions led them to use covert means find out whether Hope was being mistreated. Borrowed from a friend, they installed THIS TV just before new year’s eve, which housed a secret… a hidden camera.
LINK Towards the end of February Bernice walked into this room, and was shocked to see that her mother had a bad bruise on her face. She thought something terrible had happened. And decided to download the footage from a secret camera.

February 23rd 2015
Hope awakes at 4am and needs the toilet.
The caregiver comes back 3 minutes later.
Hope tries to stand and is forced back down.
The caregiver then elbow’s her in the head.
UPSOUND: DEREK: “With her elbow.”
Hope is forced into the bed, before her caregiver hits her with a deodorant spray can and then sprays it in her face, near her neck where her Laryngectomy hole is exposed.
BR: “It took my breath away.”
ABUSE VIDEO 5.37 “I will pull your hair if you don’t sit down.”
The caregiver searches for an injury an hour and a half later. She sees blood and wipes it away with a cloth.
BR 4.53: I then went into Sam the next day and I said to her in floods of tears, I said, do you see my mum’s bruises, she said yeah apparently your mom fell…
Bernice showed general manager – Samantha Goosen - the video. The staff member concerned - Ncediswa Mkenkcele - had worked there for 10 years.
Apparently when they did call her in, she resigned immediately upon seeing the footage.
But worse still was the abuse depicted in the remaining two months’ footage.
Midnight the 3rd of February
Hope is seen being forced into bed
…she gets up…
Ncendiswa closes the curtains.

Then a struggle ensues.
“Fight, fight, fight.”

After grabbing her hair…she kicks her.
LINK According to the footage – hope was locked down and tied to this bed. For up to 3 hours at a time, and for somebody so independent this was beyond frustrating.
On the 25TH of February, Hope was tied to her wheelchair by a different caregiver, and it was then tied to the bed. Bernice was heartbroken watching her mother’s frustration at being unable to move for 3 hours.
The footage was shown to Mike Shulze, executive director of the Lily Kirchmann complex. He said that he and other staff were shocked.
MS: Horrific, inexcusable, 2.45 we are particularly keen to see a criminal conviction in the case that has been lodged.”
D: What training do the staff have, esp Ncendiswa, in order to handle the Pressure?
MS: “The training is on going on the job – and more importantly there is a debriefing at the end of every shift.”
Although no staff made formal complaints against Hope, Mike said her family was aware that because of her dementia Hope was a difficult patient.
MS: “We had received reports of incidents with Ms. Shepherd. 1.47 lashing out and hitting, she had hit our nurses services manager and spat at her.
Mike said Hope was restrained to her wheel chair on doctor’s orders for her own safety.
D: She was left for three hours?
MS: “That again does appear, was excessive.”
Following to the video evidence, another four staff members were fired.
MS “The others were for use of her personal property, there was a carer that actually brushed her hair, with her brush, one that even used her tooth brush.”
Ncediswa was arrested and charged with Assault with intent to do Grievous Bodily Harm. She was given a warning and the case was postponed for further investigation. Ncendiswa agreed to give us her side of the story.
01:09 Derek: Why did you treat her like that?
01:14 Ncendiswa: Im not proud of what I did I just saw myself hitting her because of what she did to me it was not nice I couldn’t bare it. I am truly sorry to the Sheppard family.
02:18 Derek: How did you feel after seeing the footage?
02:31 Ncendiswa: I felt bad, I hated myself
Although Ncendiswa said she could not recall kicking Hope on the 3rd of February, she explained that on the morning of the 23rd she took Hope to the toilet.
N: she needed to do a number two I undressed her PJs with the wet Nappy as I was doing that I saw the Hand of Mrs Sheppard she slapped me with her hand which had BA! And the BA went inside my mouth and face, so I shouted at her! What are you doing?
05:29 Derek: What is BA?
05:31 Ncendiswa: It’s a Stool … I kept asking why did you do that its ugly, but then she responded with her middle finger and put the middle finger in and said you deserve it Baboon ugly thing!
06:02 Derek: She called you a Baboon?
06:03 Ncendiswa: Yes, she said you deserve it
The footage timeline shows the alleged incident would have occurred within 3 minutes. Ncendiswa said she then washed away the evidence.
12.50: Her hand still had BA even in the nails so I showered her thoroughly then dressed her we went back to her room and dried her hair.”
08:30 Derek: But surely after 12 years you’re able to handle this situation?
08:44 Ncendiswa: Yes I still ask how did I do it I still question myself why did I do it
Ncendiswa said she repeatedly asked for help with Hope.
07:55 Ncendiswa: They never advised there are no sessions … 9.12 Mrs Sheppard was hitting the nurses.
10:19 Derek: We haven’t seen any of that and heard any racist comments?
10:25 Ncendiswa: Yes but she was racist man.
10:43 Derek: We can’t hear this on the recordings we have got?
10:47 Ncendiswa: Yes because it happened in the loo.
D: Was there ever a question of racism of any sort on your mom’s side?
Daugher: No no – I can get 100 people to testify that, she really wasn’t 24.30
10:55 Derek: Why did you spray Deodorant in that hole in her throat?
10:57 Ncendiswa: I took the spray and sprayed on the face not direct into the breathing holes.
If found guilty Ncendiswa could face a possible jail sentence.
Not proud of what I did. (cries)
D: But what you’ve told us is true?
100 percent true.
Bernice took her mother to Dr. Ntandazo Puzi, a Psychiatrist at St. Marks hospital.
Dr. P “She is suffering from Post traumatic Stress Disorder…”
Dr Puzi has found abuse of elderly people to be poorly exposed.
Dr. P “Its underreported”
Carte Blanche investigated similar cases of abuse in 2001 and 2010, Doctor Puzi said that globally 1 in 20 elderly persons suffers abuse whether physically or financially.
“It’s even more tragic because she has lived her life and now…loss of dignity”
Hope is now in a new facility. She no longer faces confinement to her wheelchair and goes for daily walks. Bernice believes that is why her behavior, attitude and even her speech, have improved.
Derek: … with picture book. Lovely family.

PROMOs:
10 seconder: An elderly woman fights off abuse from her caregiver…
15 seconder: A caregiver caught on camera abusing an 84 year old woman at a well known East London care facility for the elderly…
15 seconder: A caregiver accused of assault on an elderly patient apologizes…

metadata.One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...): Smacked, punched, kicked - serious abuse at a high end elderly facility in East London. This Sunday on Carte Blanche we bring you the exclusive footage and interviews with the family of the victim.
metadata.Summary: Clips show the assaults, which took place on February 3 and 23. In the video, seen by the Daily Dispatch, Shepherd is assaulted with open hands, fists and elbows by a caregiver. In one clip the caregiver stops the assaults to close the door and curtains in Shepherd’s room before she continues assaulting the frail pensioner, even dishing out a fly-kick to the stomach. Shepherd’s feeble attempts to fight back are met with more violence. She is grabbed by her hair and roughly thrown down on her bed, where the assault continues. In another clip the caregiver is seen smashing her elbow into the elderly woman’s head and back. The footage also shows the woman taking a deodorant can and bashing it against Shepherd’s head, before spraying its contents into a breathing hole in Shepherd’s throat. The elderly woman suffers from throat cancer Home lilly kirchmann in EL. Flashbacks – they took her out of the old age home. Took her to a psychiatrist. Family home environment – the change the unbelievable – starting to talk and walk again. She wasn’t allowed to even walk. Criminal cases made against the nurses – the nurse appeared in court The abuse was discovered in December. Her daughter was having to feed her. She went every day. She had bruises and she kept having them. The nurses made up excuses. Put her to bed on the 6th December, she was fine, but the next day, she had a broken arm. X ray’s. Doctor said “funny break” Put a camera into her room. 23rd of February – she had black eyes. Again she fell. She downloaded the footage. She couldn’t believe what was going on. Ncediswa Mkenkcele appeared in court. Tieing her to the bed for hours. Pull her out of bed when she was sleep. http://www.dispatchlive.co.za/gen/how-hope-84-was-tortured/
metadata.Further information: We got exclusive interviews with the shepherd family - including hope. We also spoke with the alleged abuser Ncendiswa and she for the first time told her chilling tale of what lead her to beat an 84 year old woman. The actual facility - Lily Kirchmann - sits down with us and explains how this happened on the watch.
